research_question: Which causal Polygon equity features have a cross-sectional return relationship that survives temporal replication across fixed horizons?
technical_corrections_before_performance: Before the first outcome run, arbitrary short-interest settlement dates were mapped directly to the tenth market session strictly after settlement rather than using a session-index lookup that requires settlement itself to be a trading session. No feature, horizon, split, or gate changed.

splits.conditional_confirmation: 2022-01-01 through 2022-12-30; opened only for cells passing discovery and replication

availability.tape: SIP records strictly before 10:00; exact 10:05 entry
availability.news: same-session 09:35 only when published before 09:25 ET; otherwise next-session 09:35
availability.edgar: always next-session 09:35 because the index supplies filing date but not a safe intraday timestamp
availability.short_interest: ten market-session lag after settlement, then 09:35 entry
availability.universe: quarterly PIT market-cap top500 intersected with daily PIT eligibility; old/manual 62 unused

statistics.continuous: same-date top quintile return minus bottom quintile return
statistics.binary_edgar: event-category mean return minus other filing-event names on the same date
statistics.p_value: two-sided normal approximation to the t statistic of daily spreads
statistics.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg across every frozen discovery cell at q <= 0.10

gates.replication: same sign, directional t >= 1.0, absolute spread >= 25% of discovery, >=20 dates and >=100 observations per side

interpretation: This is an edge-discovery map, not a portfolio backtest or production PASS. Any surviving cell requires a separately preregistered full-refill compounding replay.
multiple_testing_policy: No feature, horizon, direction, split, or gate changes after the first outcome run. All cells, including failures, must be retained.
